title: Stable public address: named Cloudflare tunnel on a domain Warren owns (replaces the changing trycloudflare address)
acceptance_criteria: One fixed https hostname reaches CIP /login after any reboot or tunnel restart
Company managed Chrome can open it (it blocks *.trycloudflare.com by policy, PILOT_TUNNEL_RUNBOOK section H)
The supervisor from N-0073 runs the named tunnel; the quick tunnel stays as the fallback
Warren performs the Cloudflare sign-in and domain step himself; no Cloudflare credential is stored in the repo
